name: Repair Print Spooler
description: Restarts the Windows Print Spooler service to fix stuck print jobs or unresponsive printers. This action ensures the queue processes correctly without increasing raw printing speed.

description_i18n.en: Restarts the Windows Print Spooler service to fix stuck print jobs or unresponsive printers. This action ensures the queue processes correctly without increasing raw printing speed.
description_i18n.de: Startet den Windows-Druckwarteschlangendienst neu, um hängende Druckaufträge oder nicht reagierende Drucker zu beheben. Diese Aktion stellt sicher, dass die Warteschlange korrekt verarbeitet wird, ohne die reine Druckgeschwindigkeit zu erhöhen.
description_i18n.fr: Redémarre le service de spouleur d'impression Windows pour corriger les travaux bloqués ou les imprimantes non réactives. Cette action assure que la file est traitée correctement sans augmenter la vitesse brute d'impression.

warnings.title: Service behavior changed
warnings.message: The Print Spooler startup type is updated. This ensures the service starts automatically on boot

warnings.title: Service state change
warnings.message: Related Windows services may stop or restart briefly while the action runs

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: The script sets the Spooler service startup type to Automatic and restarts it if currently running, or starts it if stopped
